intent_en: To demonstrate that income inequality, measured by the ratio of household income at the 90th percentile to the 10th percentile, has increased steadily since 1980.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the steady increase in the ratio of household income between the upper and lower percentiles over time, highlighting the trend of rising income inequality.
narration_support: This ratio has also been rising steadily since about 1980.
chart_support: Bar chart showing the ratio of household income at the 90th percentile to income at the 10th percentile increasing from 1980 to 2019.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the ratio is rising since 1980, which aligns with the chart title 'Income inequality is on the rise' and the upward trend in bar heights from 1980 to 2019.
